*   `?g H14`: The Main Concept is an "Action/Verb/Do/Use/Button" (H14).
    *   `!r A1`: A sub-concept is an "Object/Box" (A1).
    *   `!r D8`: A sub-concept is "Time/Duration" (D8) (related to the Object/Box).
    *   `!r C13`: A sub-concept is "Ear/Sound/Hearing" (C13) (related to the Object/Box).
    *   `!y E2`: A sub-concept is "Night/Evening/Space/Moon/Star" (E2).
    *   `!y B14`: A sub-concept is "House/Dwelling/Room/Domestic" (B14).
    *   `!y G14`: A sub-concept is "Turn/Around/Cycle/Repetition" (G14).
    *   `!y C3`: A sub-concept is "Slow/Slow motion" (C3).

    *   Main Concept: An action (H14).
    *   Group Red (related to the Action):
        *   Object (A1): A Box? A case? A container?
        *   Time (D8): Duration, timing, or a specific time.
        *   Sound (C13): Hearing, ringing, or a signal.
    *   Group Yellow (related to the Action or the Object):
        *   Night/Space (E2): Nighttime, stars, space.
        *   House/Room (B14): Domestic, inside a room.
        *   Turn/Cycle (G14): Rotating, turning, cycling.
        *   Slow (C3): Slow motion, slow pace.

    *   `?g H14` (Action)
    *   `!r A1` (Object/Box), `D8` (Time), `C13` (Sound/Hearing)
